verses.1: The Lord is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.
verses.2: He made me sleep in a vineyard of wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine, wine.
verses.3: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.4: For though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff comfort me.
verses.5: You prepare a table in front of me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.6: Surely goodness and loving - kindness will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
